Description: Launches the Spring Boot application by running the PetClinicApplication class.
Return value description: Returns nothing (void).

Description: Registers runtime hints for resource patterns and serialization types to enable proper Ahead-of-Time (AOT) compilation and native image generation.
Return value description: void
Technique 1: Resource pattern registration for database files
Technique 2: Resource pattern registration for message files
Technique 3: Serialization type registration for entity classes

Description: Adds a new pet to the collection of pets if the pet is new.
Return value description: void

Description: Adds a visit to a pet identified by its ID, validating that both the pet ID and visit exist before associating them.
Return value description: void

Description: Retrieves an owner entity by ID from the database or creates a new empty owner object if no ID is provided.
Return value description: Returns an Owner object either retrieved from the database by ID or a new empty Owner instance when no ID is provided.
Technique 1: Database query using repository findById method

Description: Initializes a form for creating a new owner by returning the view template for owner creation or update.
Return value description: The name of the view template for displaying the owner creation/update form.

Description: Processes the creation of a new owner by validating the input, saving it to the repository, and redirecting to the owner's detail page.
Return value description: Returns the view name for the owner creation form if validation fails, or redirects to the owner's detail page upon successful creation.

Description: Initializes the form for finding pet owners by returning the view template name.
Return value description: Returns the string 'owners/findOwners' which represents the view template name.

Description: Handles HTTP GET requests to search for pet clinic owners by last name, returning paginated results or redirecting to a specific owner's page when exactly one match is found.
Return value description: Returns a view name string that determines the next page to render, either the search results page, a specific owner's page, or a redirect URL.

Description: Initializes a form for updating an owner's information by returning the view template name for the create or update form.
Return value description: Returns the view template name VIEWS_OWNER_CREATE_OR_UPDATE_FORM as a String.

Description: Processes the submission of an owner update form, validates the input, checks for ID mismatches, saves the updated owner data, and redirects to the owner's detail page with appropriate success or error messages.
Return value description: Returns a redirect URL string to either the owner edit form (on validation errors) or the owner detail page (on successful update).

Description: Retrieves and displays an owner's details by their ID, returning a view model containing the owner information.
Return value description: A ModelAndView object that contains the owner details and specifies the view template to render.
Technique 1: Database query to fetch owner by ID

Description: Retrieves owners from the data store whose last name starts with the given search value, returning paginated results.
Return value description: A Page containing matching Owner entities, or an empty Page if no matches are found

Description: Retrieves an Owner entity from the data store by its unique identifier.
Return value description: An Optional containing the Owner if found, or an empty Optional if no Owner exists with the provided ID.

Description: Adds a visit to the collection of visits.
Return value description: void - no value is returned

Description: Retrieves all pet types from the repository and makes them available as a model attribute for use in web views.
Return value description: A collection of PetType objects representing all available pet types in the system.
Technique 1: Spring MVC ModelAttribute annotation to expose data to web views

Description: Retrieves an owner by their ID from the repository and makes it available as a model attribute for the web request.
Return value description: An Owner object representing the owner with the specified ID.

Description: Retrieves a pet object based on owner ID and pet ID, or returns a new empty pet if no pet ID is provided.
Return value description: A Pet object representing the requested pet, or a new empty Pet object if petId is null.
Technique 1: Database query through OwnerRepository to find owner by ID
Technique 2: Exception handling for missing owner records

Description: Prevents the 'id' field from being automatically bound to the 'owner' object during web request processing.
Return value description: void

Description: Configures a WebDataBinder to use PetValidator for validating pet data during form binding operations.
Return value description: void

Description: Initializes a new pet creation form by creating a new Pet object, adding it to the specified Owner, and returning the view name for the pet creation or update form.
Return value description: Returns the view name string for the pet creation or update form.

Description: Processes a new pet creation form submission by validating the pet data, checking for duplicates, and saving the pet to the owner's record if validation passes.
Return value description: Returns the view name for the pet creation form if validation fails, or a redirect URL to the owner's detail page if successful.

Description: Returns the view name for displaying a form to edit a pet with the specified ID.
Return value description: The name of the view template that displays the pet editing form.

Description: Processes a form submission to update pet details, validates the input data, checks for duplicate pet names, ensures the birth date is not in the future, and either redirects to an edit form with errors or updates the pet information and redirects to the owner's page.
Return value description: Returns a view name for the edit form if validation fails, or a redirect URL to the owner's page when the update is successful.

Description: Returns the name of a pet type, or a placeholder string if the name is null.
Return value description: A string representing the pet type's name, or '<null>' if the name is null.

Description: Finds and returns a pet type by matching the provided text against pet type names, throwing an exception if no match is found.
Return value description: Returns the PetType object that matches the provided text, or throws a ParseException if no matching pet type is found.

Description: Retrieves all PetType entities from the data store and returns them as a sorted collection.
Return value description: A Collection of PetType objects ordered by their name.

Description: Validates a Pet object by checking if its name, type (for new pets), and birth date are properly set, adding validation errors when any required field is missing.
Return value description: void

Description: Determines whether the validator can validate instances of a given class by checking if the class is assignable from Pet.
Return value description: Returns true if the given class is Pet or a subclass of Pet, otherwise returns false.

Description: Loads a pet with its associated visit for a given owner and pet ID, ensuring fresh data and proper object initialization before handling request mappings.
Return value description: A new Visit object that has been added to the pet's visits collection.
Technique 1: Database query through OwnerRepository to find owner by ID
Technique 2: Object relationship navigation to retrieve pet from owner
Technique 3: Model attribute binding to make pet and owner available in request scope

Description: Prepares and returns the view for creating or updating a visit form for a specific pet owned by a specific owner.
Return value description: Returns the logical view name 'pets/createOrUpdateVisitForm' which will be resolved to an actual view template.

Description: Processes a new visit form submission for a pet, validates the input, saves the visit to the database, and redirects the user back to the owner's page with a success message.
Return value description: Returns a redirect URL string to the owner's page or the visit form view depending on validation results.

Description: Configures a cache named 'vets' with a specific cache configuration in the JCache manager.
Return value description: Returns a JCacheManagerCustomizer bean that customizes the cache manager configuration.

Description: Triggers an exception to demonstrate error handling behavior in the application.
Return value description: String

Description: Configures a locale resolver that stores user language preferences in session storage and defaults to English when no preference is set.
Return value description: A SessionLocaleResolver instance configured to use English as the default locale.

Description: Creates and configures a locale change interceptor that allows switching application languages via URL parameters.
Return value description: A configured LocaleChangeInterceptor that handles language switching through 'lang' URL parameters.

Description: Registers a locale change interceptor to handle internationalization by detecting and processing locale changes on each incoming HTTP request.
Return value description: void

Description: Returns a welcome message for the root path of the application.
Return value description: A string representing the view name "welcome".

Description: Adds a veterinary specialty to the internal collection of specialties.
Return value description: void

Description: Retrieves a paginated list of veterinarians and adds pagination information to the model for display in a web view.
Return value description: Returns the name of the view template ('vets.html') to render the veterinarian list.

Description: Retrieves a list of veterinarians from the repository and returns them wrapped in a Vets object for JSON serialization.
Return value description: A Vets object containing a list of veterinarian objects.

Description: Retrieves all veterinarians from the data store in a read-only transaction and caches the results.
Return value description: A collection of Vet objects representing all veterinarians in the system.
Technique 1: Database query to retrieve all Vet records
Technique 2: Database transaction management with read-only optimization

Description: Retrieves all veterinarians from the data store in paginated format.
Return value description: A paginated collection of Vet objects containing veterinarian data.
